MIND. [1] [Cit. l.]
Women who are generally very attentive, suddenly become averse to domestic duties.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cit. l.]
Headache occurs daily, compels her to lie down. θ Splenitis.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Cit. l.]
Scorbutis.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cit. l.]
Want of appetite. θ Splenitis.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cit. l.]
Empty eructations, particularly after eating. θ Splenitis.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Cit. l.]
Scrobiculum painful to pressure of hand. θ Splenitis.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Cit. l.]
Affections of spleen.
Painful enlargement of spleen.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Cit. l.]
Ascites.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Cit. l.]
Constipation. θ Splenitis.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Cit. l.]
Dropsy of scrotum.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Cit. l.]
Dyspnœa. θ Splenitis.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Cit. l.]
Great dyspnœa, almost suffocation ; sits with face bent over as far as possible ; unconsciousness ; dry skin ; cold sweat on face and arms. θ Hydrothorax following metritis.
Hydrothorax.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Cit. l.]
Stiffness of joints, particularly in fingers ; bruised feeling, particularly in feet ; she is averse to domestic duties.
   

NERVES. [36] [Cit. l.]
Convulsions from poisoning by Stramonium.
   

SKIN. [46] [Cit. l.]
Dry skin, with cold sweat on face and arms. θ Hydrothorax.
Dropsy, particularly of chest, and after scarlatina.
Herpetic eruption.
